question: Does either Hotjar (Contentsquare) or Instatus ask for a phone number, or a card, at a step after the visible sign-up form (inside the account, before the free-plan limit applies)?
why: the sign-up forms re-read 2026-11-19 have no card or phone field, so needs_card and needs_phone derive 0 with identity_basis stated; any card or phone step that appears only after registration is unverified: behind a sign-up and cannot be observed without creating an account
